title: Full gate: record per-test durations for the Rust test stage and report the slowest tests
outcome: Full gate: record per-test durations for the Rust test stage and report the slowest tests
acceptance: A full or focused run records each Rust test's duration in a bounded artifact next to the existing Node and Vitest duration reports, and the summary lists the slowest tests
Collecting durations changes no test selection, ordering assumption, coverage or pass/fail outcome
The recorded data is enough to say which tests account for most of the rust-tests execution time on a measured run
